$comment: Retention policy for agency-os/reports/*. DATA, not code -- scripts/prune-reports.ps1 is the
only enforcer, and it reads this file. Adding a report type means adding a line here.
Why this exists: on 2026-08-26 the reports tree held 5,000+ generated files. One directory
(reports/ao-close) had a retention rule, written as prose in .claude/commands/ao-close.md and
executed by hand; the other 23 had none. reports/health alone had 3,315 files / 148 MB and
reports/status 1,495, of which 1,336 were per-run copies of a backup check that passed.
Nothing was broken -- nothing was watching either, which is the same shape as the ClickHouse
recurrence this repo spent 2026-08-25 unpicking: unbounded growth that no detector measures.
The invariant this file exists to make enforceable:
every directory under agency-os/reports/ has a DECLARED retention, and a directory that
declares none is REPORTED rather than silently accumulating.
That last clause is the part that survives 30 years: a report type added in 2029 by someone
who never read this file still shows up, because the enforcer flags undeclared directories.
keepDays semantics:
<number>  delete files whose filename date-stamp is older than N days
null      keep everything, deliberately -- state why in 'why'
ALWAYS protected regardless of policy (hard-coded in prune-reports.ps1, not overridable):
- any filename containing LATEST      (the live snapshot every consumer reads)
- README.md                            (documentation, not output)
- the single newest file in the directory, even if it is past the horizon
(reports/ao-close's gate keys off the most recent file; a >90-day gap must not
make it prunable -- see .claude/commands/ao-close.md and ao-close.ps1:324-333)

health.why: 3,315 files / 148 MB, gitignored, one per health run. Failures are recorded in WORKLOG with root cause; these are point-in-time PASS snapshots.

closeout.why: 386 files, gitignored, one per doc-sync/closeout run.

guard.why: 211 files, gitignored, one per system-guard run.

status.why: Dated snapshots only; the *-LATEST.md/.json that every consumer and AGENTS.md rule reads are protected above.

ao-close.why: Pre-existing decision, previously prose in .claude/commands/ao-close.md. Preserved verbatim.

ao-resume.why: Session-start archives; same horizon as ao-close for symmetry.

oracle.why: External review artifacts. The ORACLE gate in verify-closeout-completeness.ps1 only ever reads same-day artifacts, so 90d is far beyond need while keeping a quarter of audit trail.

e2e.why: 18 MB in 28 files -- large payloads. LATEST.md is tracked and protected.

weekly.why: Weekly rollups; one year of history is small and useful for trend questions.

security.why: Audit trail for vulnerability findings; a year is the minimum useful window for 'when did this first appear'.

decisions.why: Decision records are the reason this repo can be picked up cold. Never prune.

audit.why: Logic-audit reports referenced by AUDIT_REGISTRY.md by filename.

governance.why: Governance drift reports referenced from AGENTS.md.

strategy-review.why: Strategy records; same class as decisions.
